shows.title: THE TRUTH a comedy by Florian Zeller
shows.description: This ‘deliciously funny, superbly cast and expertly constructed, 90-minutes of sharp-witted entertainment’ (Smooth Radio) peels back the lies we tell the people we love, and the ones we tell ourselves.

shows.title: Showstopper! The Kids Show
shows.description: They're back! After a hit run at Christmas last year, The Showstoppers burst back on to the Walthamstow stage for October half-term.
